Synthesize Multi-Modality DICOM Phantoms with Exact Ground-Truth Geometry

Source: R/synthesize.R
dicom_synthesize.Rd

Generates standards-compliant synthetic DICOM Part 10 datasets across classical multi-file 3D series ("CT", "MR", "PT", "DX", "MG", "US", "XA"), single-file Enhanced Multi-Frame IODs ("ENHCT", "ENHMR", "DBT"), and cine multi-frame sequences ("XA_CINE", "US_CINE"). Returns the analytical 4x4 DICOM LPS voxel-to-world affine, rescaled ground-truth voxel array with asymmetric corner fiducials, and planted synthetic PHI metadata for deterministic validation of geometry, quantitative transforms, de-identification, and NIfTI export.

Usage

dicom_synthesize(
  out_dir = tempfile("dicom_synth_"),
  modality = c("CT", "MR", "PT", "DX", "MG", "US", "XA", "ENHCT", "ENHMR", "DBT",
    "XA_CINE", "US_CINE"),
  dims = c(32L, 32L, 8L),
  spacing = c(1, 1, 2.5),
  origin = c(-16, -16, 0),
  orientation = c("axial", "coronal", "sagittal", "oblique"),
  oblique_angles_deg = c(15, -10, 5),
  gantry_tilt_deg = 0,
  irregular_z = FALSE,
  reverse_order = FALSE,
  mixed_series = FALSE,
  phi = TRUE,
  pet_params = list(),
  voi_params = list(),
  extra_tags = list(),
  seed = 42L,
  inject_phi = NULL,
  phi_profile = c("basic", "midi_b")
)

# S3 method for class 'dicom_phantom'
print(x, ...)

Arguments

out_dir

Output directory where synthesized .dcm file(s) will be written. Created automatically if it does not exist. Defaults to a new temporary directory.

modality

Imaging modality / IOD preset. One of "CT", "MR", "PT", "DX", "MG", "US", "XA", "ENHCT", "ENHMR", "DBT", "XA_CINE", or "US_CINE".

dims

Integer vector c(rows, cols, slices) (or c(rows, cols) for a single slice). Default is c(32L, 32L, 8L).

spacing

Numeric vector c(dr, dc, dz) in millimeters, where dr is row spacing (along d_col), dc is column spacing (along d_row), and dz is nominal slice step. Default is c(1.0, 1.0, 2.5).

origin

Numeric vector c(x, y, z) in DICOM LPS millimeters for voxel (r = 0, c = 0, s = 0) ([1, 1, 1] 1-based). Default is c(-16.0, -16.0, 0.0).

orientation

Anatomical acquisition plane: "axial", "coronal", "sagittal", or "oblique".

oblique_angles_deg

Numeric vector of 3 ZYX Euler angles in degrees applied when orientation = "oblique". Default is c(15, -10, 5).

gantry_tilt_deg

Numeric gantry/detector tilt angle in degrees rotating the slice step direction in the (normal, d_col) plane. Default is 0.

irregular_z

Logical. If TRUE (and slices >= 2), introduces a deterministic 2 * dz slice gap after slice floor(slices / 2). Default is FALSE.

reverse_order

Logical. If TRUE, writes slices/frames on disk in reverse spatial order (slices:1) while keeping truth_affine_lps and truth_voxels in canonical ascending IPP . normal order. Default is FALSE.

mixed_series

Logical. If TRUE, writes an additional scout/localizer DICOM slice with distinct orientation and matrix dimensions into out_dir (recorded in phantom$extra_files) sharing the same SeriesInstanceUID. Default is FALSE.

phi

Logical. If TRUE (default), plants synthetic fictitious PHI tags (and burned-in top-row pixels for "US" / "US_CINE"). If FALSE, writes clean de-identified tags.

pet_params

Optional named list configuring quantitative PET ("PT") attributes (patient_weight, patient_size, patient_sex, series_time, acquisition_time, total_dose, half_life, start_time, units, corrected_image, decay_correction, activity_bqml, rescale_slope, rescale_intercept).

voi_params

Optional named list configuring "MG" / "DX" / "DBT" VOI LUT and presentation attributes (presentation_intent, photometric, voi_lut_function, window_center, window_width).

extra_tags

Optional named list of additional top-level DICOM tags or private tags (e.g. list("(2005,100D)" = "0", "(2005,100E)" = "2.5")) to embed in every written file.

seed

Optional integer seed reserved for deterministic phantom extensions without mutating the caller's .Random.seed. Default is 42L.

inject_phi

Optional logical alias for phi. If provided, overrides phi.

phi_profile

Character string specifying the synthetic PHI profile:

  • "basic" (default): Plants core identity tags (name, ID, birthdate, institution).

  • "midi_b": Plants comprehensive HIPAA Safe Harbor, PS3.15, and SG/MY/EU canaries across headers, sequences (ReferencedSOPSequence), safe/unsafe private blocks, and burned-in pixel annotation banners.

x

A "dicom_phantom" object returned by dicom_synthesize().

...

Additional arguments (unused).

Value

Invisibly returns an S3 object of class "dicom_phantom" containing:

  • files: character vector of primary .dcm file paths

  • extra_files: character vector of extra .dcm files when mixed_series = TRUE

  • out_dir: normalized output directory path

  • modality: requested modality string

  • dims: integer vector c(rows, cols, slices)

  • orientation: canonical orientation string ("axial", "coronal", "sagittal", or "oblique")

  • truth_affine_lps: 4x4 numeric LPS voxel-to-world affine matrix (0-based [r, c, s, 1])

  • truth_voxels: [rows, cols, slices] numeric array in rescaled units

  • direction: list with d_row, d_col, and normal unit vectors in LPS

  • spacing: numeric vector c(dr, dc, dz)

  • slice_positions_lps: nslices x 3 numeric matrix of canonical slice origins in LPS

  • planted_phi: named list of planted synthetic PHI tags (empty list() when phi = FALSE)

  • phi_manifest: tibble of planted PHI canaries with columns tag, keyword, sequence_path, value, expected_action, and category

  • phi_profile: character string identifying the active PHI profile

  • uids: list with study_uid, series_uid, and frame_of_reference_uid

Examples

out_dir <- tempfile("ct_phantom_")
phantom <- dicom_synthesize(
  out_dir = out_dir,
  modality = "CT",
  dims = c(16L, 16L, 4L),
  spacing = c(0.8, 0.8, 2.5),
  orientation = "oblique"
)
phantom
#> <dicom_phantom [CT] 16x16x4 | spacing=(0.8, 0.8, 2.5) mm | orientation=oblique | files=4 | phi=planted>
unlink(out_dir, recursive = TRUE)
